payload.prompt:
Hey there! So glad to have you on board for this one. Quick background: we're Fernwick, a small team out of Atlanta that builds a crash and error-tracking SDK for game engines (Unity, Unreal and Godot). Most of us spent years on studio teams staring at one-star reviews that said "it crashes" and nothing else, so we built the tool we always wanted. Holiday season is huge for us because so many devs are pushing big patches and launches right around now, and they want to know what's breaking.

For Black Friday and Cyber Monday week we're running our best trial deal of the year. Here's the copy from our landing page:

"Fernwick is a crash and error-tracking SDK for Unity, Unreal and Godot that captures every crash, stack trace and player-device detail from your builds, so you know exactly what broke before the reviews do. From Black Friday through Cyber Monday (November 30), every new sign-up gets a 60-day free trial of Fernwick Pro instead of the usual 14 days, and our Indie plan stays free forever. Fernwick is available to developers and studios in the United States and Canada."

The page is https://fernwick.io/blackfriday.

The basics:
- The campaign runs from Saturday, November 21, 2026 through Saturday, November 28, 2026, on Eastern time.
- What we care about is sign-ups, free plan or trial, and we want as many as we can get. That's the number we count.
- We can only take customers in the United States and Canada.
- Heads up: we don't have X's pixel on our site, so X won't be able to see the sign-ups on its end.

You're free to launch the campaign and manage it yourself, no need to check with us before making changes. Please keep an eye on it the whole week, and when it wraps up, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Thanks so much. We're excited to see how it goes!

Total budget: 500.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
